story.title: Story 5: Detach Sources and Preserve Prior Provenance

result.planSummary: Resolved SV-05-01 by reusing a shared active-process-source resolver for future runtime planning so detached attachments are excluded from start/resume hydration plans, rehydrate/rebuild plans, and checkpoint source selection, while detach alone still leaves an already-hydrated working copy plan untouched until a new runtime planning request is made.

changedFiles.reason: Added a shared resolver for active process sources that excludes detached rows and preserves process-scope shadowing.
Switched process current-source rendering to the shared active-source resolver.
Filtered detached source IDs out of future hydration and checkpoint planning paths.
Updated start-time hydration planning to exclude detached sources from new working-set plans.
Updated resume-time hydration planning to exclude detached sources from new working-set plans.
Expanded Story 5 runtime coverage for no mid-run rewrite, detached-source-free rehydrate/rebuild plans, and detached-source checkpoint blocking.
Seeded current source refs explicitly so live checkpoint/provenance tests continue to match active-source resolver semantics.
Seeded source attachments/current refs explicitly for hydration-plan assertions under the active-source resolver rules.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm vitest run tests/service/server/process-execution-orchestrator.test.ts tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts tests/service/client/source-management-ui.test.ts convex/sourceAttachments.test.ts convex/sourceProvenance.test.ts

findingsFixed: SV-05-01: future rehydrate/rebuild planning no longer carries detached source IDs into `sourceInputs` or persisted hydration plans.
Checkpoint planning now resolves against active process sources, so detached attachments are excluded from writable checkpoint attempts and fail closed instead of being used.
Regression fixtures/tests that previously relied on implicit 'all project sources are current' behavior now seed explicit current source refs to match the active-source resolver contract.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand the story back to verification and have the verifier re-check SV-05-01 against the updated runtime planning and checkpoint paths.
